name: Invite links: a single-use link that makes an account, its memberships and one pre-approved worker agent
summary: A person's session (never an agent or worker credential) that is a superuser or an owner (project.admin, the Members table's rule) of every named project makes an invite, checked at create and again at redeem; a coordinator who is not an owner may not. Routes: GET/POST /v1/invites, POST /v1/invites/{id}/revoke (inviter or superuser). The token is secrets.token_urlsafe(32); state['invites'] keeps only its SHA-256, the projects, the optional worker agent (no coordinator grant, no scopes) and an expiry of 72 hours by default, at most 7 days. The signed-out page (#/invite/TOKEN) reads POST /v1/invites/view and redeems with POST /v1/invites/redeem: in one Service._widening under the state lock it creates the account, the contributor memberships, the agent and its credential (as create_agent issues it) and marks the invite used with the address; any failure takes all of it back. Unknown, expired, used and revoked tokens get one 404 answer and count as failed sign-ins do. Each use writes invites.redeemed into each named project's audit. Off unless invites_enabled.
